name: cadenceux-developer-experience
description: The developer experience for agentic Claris FileMaker work, with or without Claris's Agentic Development Kit (ADK): directs the Developer and the Agent through agile sprints with six development hats and de Bono's thinking hats, routes each task to the skill or ADK tool that owns it, checks the stack is current, and guides the decisions around the code (native or web viewer, data access, FileMaker 26.0.3 and earlier, reviews, linter tests, security and deployment). Also published as cadenceux-dx and fmp-dev-orchestrator.
